title: When does The Switch get flicked?
author: lophtt
selftext: At what point does “it’s shit because it’s AI” to “It’s fukn sick because it’s AI”? Will hybrid be better than pure AI games?

comments.author: BandicootWide8250
comments.body:
No one will think it's sick because it's AI.

  
Eventually people will release games that are in a finished state, polished, and fun and that's when people will stop caring. Similar to how AI memes, videos, pictures, etc, are slowly becoming more accepted and mainstream.

  
The only thing that really hurts the optics of it right now are low effort games that they can point and laugh at, because they aren't ready. People just want to play fun and well-polished games.

replies.author: delicious_pubes
replies.body: People posting their slop is the will smith eating spaghetti era of AI assisted game creation

comments.author: MelodramaticShape
comments.body: Good game is good. Bad game is bad. That's it. Stop peddling this AI wars BS.

replies.author: lophtt
replies.body: I agree, I was just curious

replies.author: Novaworld7
replies.body: Stop caring about the noise focus on the signal.

replies.author: DealerIcy3439
replies.body: Basically the big identifier. Good will be good

comments.author: ComSenseisnotCommon
comments.body:
I think eventionally someone will develop an experience only possible with gen ai.  However I think in order to do that we need to exit the dial up phase where every token has a cost like how the early days of the internet was.  

When you can get unlimited amount of tokens a month which might sound crazy now but I guarantee will be a day, there will be mind blowing experiences we never would have thought of.

replies.author: lophtt
replies.body: Yeah it’ll be like having an internet connection from some provider. Why aren’t internet companies just bundling with a specific AI service stack? (Or maybe they do already 🤷)

comments.author: blackskies69
comments.body: I think pure AI games will become more popular over time. It just comes down to people making the right novel experiences and for AI to leave its 'geo cities' phase. AI games can test and prototype novel mechanics faster than a team of developers can, so eventually people are going to figure out things to do with AI in game development you just can't do with human developers alone.

comments.author: play-what-you-love
comments.body: The other day, I saw a beautiful woman in real life and thought, "She looks AI generated". That's how fast the switch will come

comments.author: Braunb8888
comments.body: I mean look at ai vr mods. They make native vr games look primitive in comparison.

comments.author: zayelion
comments.body: Its when they update the image generator for OpenAI.

comments.author: Dry-Calligrapher-857
comments.body:
Nothing is good or bad due to AI 

A game is good or bad due to fun and design and user feeling 

When people do good games with AI that sould be a good thing for the industry, and when they release slop mcslopity slop it will harm

Thats the cycle we are into

comments.author: TamiasciurusDouglas
comments.body: Don't forget to touch grass, my friends.

comments.author: barret232hxc
comments.body: before it was asset flips. Slop was always a problem, now it's just easier to create it than ever before. People can tell the game used AI by just looking at it. It's not hard to spot a game that was handcrafted versus made by AI. Just like with images you can just tell. But if you can make it fun and look good you have a shot just like non ai assisted games have a shot, not a guarantee but a shot in the dark at most.
